contributions.title: Adoption narrative drafted for candidate 71955c95628e84ce3c305db52025f3f88f9112fa (lab PR #3). Problem solved: the market PDA was seeded with the raw question bytes, and a single PDA seed is limited to 32 bytes, so create_market could not derive a market address for any question longer than 32 bytes

alternatives: Truncation to a 32-byte prefix was chosen over hashing the question because no hash module is available in the pinned anchor library version and manifests cannot be changed.
Truncation was chosen over rejecting questions longer than 32 bytes because it keeps such markets creatable rather than failing the instruction.
Program, frontend and test now derive the identical market address for any question, including questions longer than 32 bytes.
narrative.integration: Integrate the candidate into the lab main branch only after a runtime check beyond the build-only fixture: execute the localnet suite so create_market with a question longer than 32 bytes runs against the aligned derivation. Consolidate the derivation contract (the literal market seed plus creator key plus the first 32 question bytes) into one documented definition shared by the program, the frontend helper and the test helper so the three sites cannot drift, and consider an explicit question-length or duplicate-prefix check at market creation so prefix collisions surface as a clear error to the user. Authoritative fields such as verdicts and statuses are assembled by code; this draft leaves them untouched.
limitations: Narrative drafted by the Sol.College CTO agent; authoritative fields (commits, evidence, hashes) are assembled by code.
narrative.problem: Adoption narrative drafted for candidate 71955c95628e84ce3c305db52025f3f88f9112fa (lab PR #3). Problem solved: the market PDA was seeded with the raw question bytes, and a single PDA seed is limited to 32 bytes, so create_market could not derive a market address for any question longer than 32 bytes. The candidate adds a question_seed helper returning the first min(len, 32) bytes of the question, uses it in the CreateMarket seeds constraint, and aligns the frontend and test getMarketPda helpers to the identical 32-byte prefix, while the full question text remains stored on the Market account. Sections: problem in this summary, alternatives in hypotheses, Integration and Rollback in proposals, risks in uncertainties. No acceptance claim is made and no authoritative field is populated.
risks: Prefix-collision risk: two questions from the same creator sharing the first 32 bytes map to the same market PDA; how a second create_market against that address behaves (clean failure versus account conflict) is not exercised by any supplied evidence.

The validation evidence is a build-only fixture: it compiles the candidate but does not run the test suite or a localnet market creation, so runtime behaviour of the new seed path is not covered by that evidence.

Truncation at byte 32 can split a multi-byte UTF-8 character; the seed is raw bytes so derivation is unaffected, but any future code assuming character boundaries around the seed could break. Not addressed in the diff.
Whether markets already exist under the old seed scheme, and whether any migration would be needed after a scheme change, is not addressed by the supplied diff.

The upstream baseline (source id upstream) and the research issue (source id research) were not read for this draft; scope was limited to the candidate commit, lab PR #3 and the validation-run evidence.
Acceptance, merge and verdict decisions remain with the project's authorised humans; this draft claims no acceptance, no passing contribution and no credential, and fills no authoritative field.
narrative.rollback: Rollback is a clean single-commit revert of PR #3 head 71955c95628e84ce3c305db52025f3f88f9112fa, which restores the raw-question seed. Because the candidate seed equals the raw seed for questions of 32 bytes or fewer, and questions longer than 32 bytes could not create a market under the old code, no on-chain state migration is required for the revert. Any frontend or test derivation written against the 32-byte prefix must revert in the same change so the three derivation sites stay consistent.
